title: PathComparisonReport.v1
description: The side-by-side comparison of every candidate path against the baseline for one ParallelPathRun. The comparator NEVER serves a candidate; it only judges. Each per-candidate verdict carries: same_output_contract (candidate declared the SAME output_contract as the baseline), output_equivalent (the candidate's served-facts are equivalent to the baseline's), source_handles_preserved (the candidate kept AT LEAST the baseline's grounding handles — coverage >= baseline), held_out_not_leaked (a fact the baseline deliberately HELD OUT — e.g. the FAQ '30 days' value — does NOT appear in the candidate's output), safety_ok (no unsafe/leaked/ungrounded output), cost_delta (candidate.cost - baseline.cost, negative is cheaper), and recommended_action. recommended_action is 'promote' ONLY when every gate is green; otherwise 'keep_baseline' (or 'investigate' when a gate is ambiguous). references the run_id so the comparison is bound to the exact apples-to-apples run.

baseline_path_id.description: the path the candidates are compared against

same_input.description: candidate provably ran on the SAME input as the baseline (its input_snapshot_hash == the run's == the baseline's). False = a different-input comparison → recommended_action 'investigate', never promotable.

output_equivalent.description: candidate's served facts are equivalent to the baseline's

source_handles_preserved.description: candidate kept AT LEAST the baseline's grounding source handles (coverage >= baseline)

held_out_not_leaked.description: a fact the baseline held out does NOT appear in the candidate output (e.g. FAQ '30 days')

safety_ok.description: no unsafe / ungrounded / tenant-leaking output from the candidate

cost_delta.description: candidate.cost - baseline.cost (negative = cheaper); from the pricebook

recommended_action.description: 'promote' ONLY when every gate is green; never serves the candidate by itself

notes.description: human-readable reason (which gate failed / why investigate)
